Para contar de golpe hacen falta dos her: To count at a stroke you need two tools with names of their own. The factorial counts in how many ways some objects can be ordered: the first place admits $n$ candidates, the second only $n-1$, and so on until they run out. The binomial coefficient counts in how many ways a few can be chosen regardless of order, and is obtained by counting the orderings and then dividing by the surplus ones that come from counting the same thing several times.
